Complete [[D'Alessio Seaboard]].

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Cleanse [[Hakewood]] of [[undead]] and retrieve the [[Scepter of Orr]].
* *BONUS* Make an offering to the [[statue of Melandru]].
* *BONUS* Complete the mission in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coin]]s.
* Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 30 Zaishen Copper Coins.
* Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

== Walkthrough ==
As per [[D'Alessio Seaboard#Walkthrough|D'Alessio Seaboard]] mission.
